USTA FLORIDA RELEASES 2026 STATE OF FLORIDA TENNIS REPORT

November 14, 2026 14:00 ET  | Source: USTA Florida USTA Florida

ORLANDO, FLORIDA, Nov. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- USTA Florida today released its 2026 State of Florida Tennis Report, the most complete picture the organization has ever produced of who plays tennis in Florida, where they play, and what it will take to welcome the millions more who want to. 

“This report is the single best source of information on Florida Tennis, where it’s growing, where it’s lagging, and where we have opportunities to grow,” said Chuck Gill, USTA Florida President.  “Every tennis facility and provider in the state should be using this information to double down on their investments in tennis.  It’s not about growing our programs, it’s about growing the whole tennis landscape to strengthen our communities.” 

The report finds Florida tennis growing faster than the nation. About 1.95 million Floridians played tennis in 2025, up from 1.2 million in 2019, and the state’s participation rate reached 9.1%, above the national rate of 8.8%. In the latest year alone, Florida’s rate rose 1.1 points against 0.5 points nationally.
